rules.name: grasa-month-vol-fallback-cfs
rules.sql: WITH pm(product, contract_month) AS (VALUES ('CM BO','F27.F27'), ('CM BO','H27.H27'), ('CM BO','Z26.Z26'), ('CM C','N27.N27'), ('CM C','U27.U27'), ('CM C','Z26.Z26'), ('CM CRD','U27.U27'), ('CM CT','H27.H27'), ('CM CT','K27.K27'), ('CM CT','N27.N27'), ('CM CT','Z26.Z26'), ('CM CT','Z27.Z27'), ('CM KC','Z26.Z26'), ('CM KO','F27.F27'), ('CM MW','Z27.Z27'), ('CM OR','X26.X26'), ('CM OR','Z26.Z26'), ('CM OR EUR','F27.F27'), ('CM OR EUR','G27.G27'), ('CM OR EUR','H27.H27'), ('CM OR EUR','J27.J27'), ('CM OR EUR','K27.K27'), ('CM OR EUR','M27.M27'), ('CM OR EUR','N27.N27'), ('CM OR EUR','Q27.Q27'), ('CM OR EUR','X26.X26'), ('CM OR EUR','Z26.Z26'), ('CM QC','Z26.Z26'), ('CM S','H27.H27'), ('CM S','K27.K27'), ('CM S','N27.N27'), ('CM S','X26.X26'), ('CM SB','H27.H27'), ('CM SM','F27.F27'), ('CM SM','H27.H27'), ('CM SM','K27.K27'), ('CM SM','Z26.Z26'), ('CM W','Z26.Z26')), vd AS (SELECT tenant_id, value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), v AS ( SELECT pm.product, pm.contract_month, m.vol1_id, COUNT(*) AS securities FROM pm LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table m ON m.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND upper(trim(m.product_code)) = upper(trim(pm.product)) AND m.contract_month = pm.contract_month AND upper(m.business_unit) = :bu AND m.status = 'Active' AND m.vol1_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pm.product, pm.contract_month, m.vol1_id) SELECT v.product, v.contract_month, v.vol1_id, v.securities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM opera.settlement_vol_surf_table sv WHERE sv.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND sv.vol_id = v.vol1_id AND sv.value_date = (SELECT value_date FROM vd)) AS surface_rows FROM v ORDER BY v.product, v.contract_month, v.vol1_id
